title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Instant Transfer Amount to an External Debit Card
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — how the instant transfer amount is reached.**

The instant transfer amount is the lowest of the instant percentage room, the instant pay-period room, the instant day room and the tier's largest single transfer; it is never below zero and is rounded down to the cent.

| Quantity | Definition |
|---|---|
| Instant percentage room | the tier's access percentage, divided by one hundred, times the instant accrued net, less the instant period taken |
| Instant pay-period room | the tier's pay-period dollar ceiling less the instant period taken |
| Instant day room | the tier's daily dollar ceiling less the amount of every transfer booked on the plan today, returned or not |
| Instant period taken | the amount of the plan's transfers carrying its next payday less the amount of the plan's transfer returns carrying that date |
| Instant accrued net | the net amount of the plan's earnings sync lines carrying its next payday less the net amount of its earnings correction lines carrying that date, each line at its recorded net amount, regular-hours lines always counting, overtime lines only where the tier counts overtime, shift-differential lines only where the tier counts shift differential and card tips lines only where the tier counts card tips; on a tier whose earnings availability lag is one day, sync and correction lines whose work date is today do not count |

Toward the instant percentage room and the instant pay-period room a returned or cancelled transfer does not count, and toward the instant day room every transfer booked on the plan today counts, returned or not.

**Order of operation.** Adjustments are applied in this order: any that acts on the instant percentage room and the instant pay-period room first, and then any that multiplies the lowest of the rooms, one after another, before the amount is rounded down.

## Worked example (hypothetical plan on Paystride Access Preferred)

- Earnings lines carrying the next payday: regular hours 520.00, overtime 44.00, shift differential 18.60 and card tips 30.00 USD, less a correction of 12.60 USD: instant accrued net 600.00 USD (the tier has no lag, so a line worked today counts).
- Transfers carrying the next payday total 137.50 USD with no returns; 57.50 USD of them were booked today.
- Instant percentage room: 50 divided by one hundred times 600.00, 300.00, less 137.50: **162.50 USD**. Instant pay-period room: 750.00 less 137.50, 612.50 USD. Instant day room: 300.00 less 57.50, 242.50 USD. Largest single transfer: 300.00 USD.
- Instant transfer amount: the lowest, **162.50 USD**.

*Return in the period:* had 22.50 USD of today's 57.50 USD been returned, the instant period taken would be 115.00 USD and the percentage room 185.00 USD, while the day room would stay 242.50 USD, the returned transfer still counting toward the day.
